{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Dataset shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Patient_id duplicates:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Unique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique responded values:", df['responded'].unique())
print("Sample_seq range:", df['sample_seq'].min(), "to", df['sample_seq'].max())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
